info.name: Hostel Room Allocation API
info.description:
Walks the hostel workflow: rooms, requests and the waiting list, approval with capacity checks, rejection reasons, cancelling, vacating and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8103). Repeatable: it registers fresh students and creates uniquely numbered rooms each run.

item.name: Register a fresh student for this run
Login as a seeded student with a room
Create a single room with one bed
Duplicate room number is rejected (case ignored)

exec: pm.test("Contains the new single room, no occupant names", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("roomId")); pm.expect(r.bedsLeft).to.eql(1); pm.expect(r.occupants).to.eql([]); });
pm.test("Pending with a queue position", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(r.queuePosition).to.be.a("number"); });

item.name: A second pending request is a conflict
A student who already has a room cannot ask

exec: pm.test("Found, with the student's name", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("requestId")); pm.expect(r.studentName).to.eql("Postman Student"); });

item.name: Approve without a room is rejected
Close the single room for maintenance
A closed room cannot be allocated

exec: pm.test("Approved with the room", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(r.roomNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("roomNo")); pm.expect(r.decidedBy).to.eql("warden"); });

item.name: Rejecting a decided request is a conflict

exec: pm.test("In the single room", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.roomNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("roomNo")); pm.expect(a.active).to.be.true; });

item.name: The room is no longer offered
The student cannot ask again while living there
Room is shown full to the warden with the occupant

exec: pm.test("Occupied", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("roomId")); pm.expect(r.occupied).to.eql(1); pm.expect(r.occupants).to.eql(["Postman Student"]); });

item.name: Editing the double room keeps its data
A second student requests the same room
A full room refuses student B
Another student cannot cancel B's request

exec: pm.test("Rejected with the reason", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(r.decisionReason).to.eql("No single rooms left"); });

item.name: Student B asks again and cancels

exec: pm.test("Postman student listed as left", () => { const a = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("allocationId")); pm.expect(a.active).to.be.false; });
